About GROWNSY

At GROWNSY, we create thoughtful baby-care products that help make feeding, soothing, sleep, and everyday health routines simpler for modern families. Through creator partnerships, we hope to demonstrate how our products work in real homes, support parents through practical education, and build trusted, long-term connections with communities navigating pregnancy, newborn care, and early parenthood.

Who We’re Looking For

  • Parenting, motherhood, fatherhood, and family-lifestyle creators  
  • Newborn-care, baby-feeding, sleep, or baby-wellness specialists  
  • Creators whose audiences include expecting and new parents  
  • KOLs who produce honest reviews and practical product demonstrations  
  • Creators skilled in tutorials, short-form videos, and daily-routine content  
  • Travel and on-the-go parenting content creators  
  • Safety-conscious creators who communicate clearly and responsibly  
  • Long-term partners who genuinely connect with GROWNSY’s mission

Featured Products

Grownsy NutriChef Baby Food Maker with Steam Basket

Grownsy NutriChef makes fresh baby food easier by steaming and blending in one streamlined process. Its elevated steam basket helps preserve flavor and nutrients, while two mixing modes create textures from smooth first purees to thicker meals. Sterilizer mode, BPA-free Tritan materials, stainless-steel blades, and dishwasher-safe removable parts simplify safe daily preparation.

GROWNSY Baby Swing for Infants, Dual Motion Rocker

This dual-motion infant swing offers front-to-back and side-to-side movement, five adjustable speeds, 270-degree rotation, and two recline positions for different soothing preferences. Fifteen built-in sounds, custom audio, motion-responsive swinging, and touch or remote controls add convenience. A reversible washable cushion, toy bar, locking mechanisms, and five-point harness support comfortable, supervised awake-time use.

Grownsy SniffEase Hospital-Grade Nasal Aspirator

Grownsy SniffEase helps parents clear a baby’s nasal passages gently and comfortably. Two ultra-soft silicone tips in different sizes are designed for delicate nostrils, while the compact body fits easily inside a diaper bag. Convenient USB charging keeps this portable aspirator ready for stuffy-nose moments at home, during errands, or while traveling.

Grownsy Portable Bottle Warmer for Travel

Made for feeding away from home, this 2-in-1 portable warmer lets parents warm and feed without transferring milk. Its 100-watt heater warms four ounces of water to 104°F in about 1.5 minutes or breast milk to 98°F in four minutes. Dual temperature modes, a two-hour keep-warm function, 18,000mAh battery, detachable parts, and a leak-proof lid simplify travel.

Grownsy EaseClean Pro Bottle Washer

The Grownsy EaseClean Pro automates washing, steam sterilizing, drying, and storage for bottles, pump parts, pacifiers, and feeding accessories. Its 24,000Pa pressure and 26 spray jets provide comprehensive cleaning, while 212°F steam and hot-air drying prepare items for reuse. Custom programs, self-cleaning mode, HEPA-filtered 72-hour storage, and capacity for up to eight bottles streamline demanding feeding routines.
